name: Movie Token
rootCause: Movie Token was exploited on BNB Chain on 10 March 2026 for approximately $242,000, after a double-counting and burn flaw in its deflationary token contract allowed an attacker to manipulate pool reserves and profit via price distortion. A double-counting bug in the sell logic allowed both a transfer to the liquidity pair and a duplicate addition to the pending burn tracker. Burning from the pair's reserve without restriction created an artificial supply shock, inflating the token price for attacker profit.
